segment.source: Renders a poster frame with a play control over it; headline and lead sit on the scrim, and the control opens the linked recording in a full-screen overlay. Use it for: brand films, conference recaps, launch films, product tours that are better watched than read. Prefer 'Full-Bleed Image Hero' when there is no film to play, and 'Rotating Backdrop Hero' when several stills would say more than one moving picture.
